findings: Only the fixed new receive-v2 directory is writable; original stage, provider, guard and P1 capsule remain unchanged.
Receiver freezes source controls, per-part pins, complete capsule hash, 267 regular archive members, four source anchors and 496 original path mappings.
Capsule members are checked in memory; extraction, provider installation and Lean execution are absent.
Pending files belong only to this new receiver and are linked only after exact readback; successful outputs cannot be replaced with different bytes.
Queue space is checked before each submission, two waiting slots remain reserved, and unknown outcomes require read-only recovery.
All payload-bearing commands and raw task responses stay outside the repository.
